BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CI TY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbol.s and indications as shown on Map
No. 4-H in the area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West 21" Street; a line 25 feet east of and parallel to South Oakley
Avenue; West 21" Street; and South Oakley Avenue;



to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property:              2258 West 2 P' Street
                                                                 mi FCR puBucArm
                PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                   TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                           2258 West 21^* Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone fronn B3-2 Community Shopping District to B2-3 Neighborhood
Mixed-Use District

The purpose of the rezoning Is to establish a sixth dwelling unit in an existing building
containing 5 dwelling units. After rezoning the property will contain 6 dwelling units with 2
parking spaces and no commercial space. No changes will be made to the exterior of the
property or its structure. The existing building's size and massing will remain the same. The
existing height of 39'6" will remain the same. The property is a TSL location within 1,320 of
Western Avenue.

                     Density MLA (Lot area     520.83 sq. ft. (6 DU's)
                     per unit)

                     Building SF               5,897 SF
                     FAR                        1.88
                     Building Height                40 feet (existing)



          *The applicant will seek Transit Served Location relief for the required 1 additional
          parking space.
